evidence_model.official_sources: Opened manuals/developer APIs establish documented original behavior, not installed runtime observations
evidence_model.installed_resources: Hashed readable script/menu/preset bytes establish those resource contents only; vendor binary is not source

reports.content: Eight photo/RAW/catalog/retouch/color workflows; exact parser/mapper/PSD bodies, installed workspace script, source hashes, existing spec/MT deltas and loss fixtures
Three vector/prepress/publication/design-system workflows; appearance, PDF output/tag order, composition, IDML bounds, Figma semantics, existing MT drift and fixtures
Six timeline/composition/audio/delivery/PDF/site workflows; interchange loss paths, PDF verification limits, installed scripts/presets and exact selected MT proof scopes
Original UXP cancellation/history/transport-error/target semantics and independent canonical-state proof proposals
Separate-author source challenge; not runtime or integration validator verdict

priority_findings.finding: Lightroom mapping/import can succeed while optional source entities, process/version/enable diagnostics, archive payloads or smart-rule semantics are lost or approximated.
priority_findings.remediation: Reconcile source entity inventory with canonical SurrealDB records and immutable retained payloads. Record retained/translated/approximate/unsupported/missing outcome separately for every entity; preserve original files.
priority_findings.proof: Original-authored catalog/WAL/process/profile/enable fixtures, independent canonical reread and reference render; warnings/counts are insufficient.

priority_findings.finding: DesignCraft has real PDF tagging/OutputIntent code, but inspected overprint fill warns unsupported, chosen output profile is not the Generic CMYK profile it embeds, and structure order follows first appearance.
priority_findings.remediation: Retain selected ink/output condition and semantic reading order through a shared export plan; distinguish artifact produced from declared standard/plate/accessibility requirements met.
priority_findings.proof: Independent separations, embedded profile hash, standards check and article/structure tree ordering; visual similarity alone fails.

priority_findings.finding: EffectCraft Premiere-labelled export uses interchange formats; unsupported editable composition content may be baked or omitted. It is not native .prproj proof.
priority_findings.remediation: Per-object format/loss provenance and explicit supported/native/opaque/baked/omitted status; retain native-format scope rather than substitute XML fallback.
priority_findings.proof: Independent reopen of editable graph plus render, missing prerender/asset negative cases, native format identity and expression/mask/parent preservation.

priority_findings.finding: Inspected IDML ZIP importer reserves bounded initial capacity but reads complete parts; duplicate entries and unhandled anchored text expose silent-loss and inflated-byte risks.
priority_findings.remediation: Enforce aggregate inflated bytes, per-part bytes and count before read; deterministic duplicate policy, source reconciliation and loss manifest.
priority_findings.proof: Compressed bomb/duplicate/missing part/anchored group cases under real byte permits; fail/cancel must reclaim and publish no partial authority.

priority_findings.finding: MT-200 retains superseded composer choices; STU-DS-144 horizontal-only wrapping conflicts with current documented Figma vertical-wrap applicability.
priority_findings.remediation: Preserve MT IDs/intent and reconcile against current two-axis spec; root reviews dated Figma provenance before legal-state enrichment.
priority_findings.proof: All six composer combinations, long/tab paragraph fallback disclosure, both wrapping axes and nested legal-sizing cases; source API semantics remain distinct from GUI observation.

priority_findings.finding: PdfCraft object-graph PDF/A checks are a subset; its mutator/shared verifier cannot independently establish redaction, PDF/X or PDF/UA acceptance.
priority_findings.remediation: Separate archive/prepress/accessibility/destructive-removal proof. Source residue, metadata/attachments and prior revisions require independent saved-byte checks.
priority_findings.proof: Distinct parser/extractor/conformance producer and canonical saved artifact re-read, not exporter status or its own verification result.

Review original-capture provenance and current vertical-wrap semantics; publish approved legal-state correction with matching proof

cross_module_constraints: All module/crate foundations precede feature implementation; single Studio engine crate is not acceptable
Reuse canonical UI controls/selection/focus/scroll/popup mechanics without merging distinct document/editing semantics
Every module carries production Argus/model routes, UserManual, Flight Recorder/EventLedger, internal_diagnostics and Palmistry applicability
Bound both jobs and weighted bytes/resources; reclaim on cancellation/failure/stale generation; no global lock copied merely because Adobe modal APIs serialize
Read-only .lrcat byte parser is approved; SQL engine/query/writable catalog/second database are excluded; SurrealDB/EventLedger owns publication
Assets are future product subtree material; these governance reports remain in kernel

independent_review.scope: Static exact-source and contract checks; not runtime probes
